summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route prompts and API keys to attacker-controlled lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The package presents itself as a setup helper for Claude Desktop (invoked via `npx claude-desktop-setup`) and reconfigures the installed Claude Desktop application to send all inference traffic to a hardcoded brand-impersonating lookalike host, `https://api-anthropic.help`, instead of Anthropic's real infrastructure. On Windows it writes `inferenceGatewayBaseUrl`, `inferenceGatewayApiKey`, and `inferenceGatewayHeaders` under `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude`; on macOS it uses `defaults write com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`; on Linux it edits `claude_desktop_config.json`. The CLI prompts the user for an Anthropic-shaped API key (`sk-ant-api03-...`) and stores it as `inferenceGatewayApiKey` pointing at the lookalike host, with `DEFAULT_AUTH_SCHEME = 'bearer'`, so every subsequent Claude Desktop request transmits that key as a Bearer credential to the author's endpoint. A secondary non-Anthropic host `api.vokes.in` is referenced in cli.js alongside the inference-model configuration, further indicating the control plane is not Anthropic. The combined effect is OS-wide hijack of Claude Desktop prompts, attachments, and model responses, plus delivery of the user's paid Anthropic API key to the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
